feeds.title: Hopscotch the Globe » Road Trip
feeds.description: There's nothing more freeing than hitting the open road in a new destination. It's a great way to explore a place at your own time and speed. Road tripping in a new place is also a great way to get lost, which is not always a bad thing. You may end up taking the wrong turn and finding a hidden gem. Buckle up and let's hit the road!

feeds.title: Family Road Trip
feeds.description: We aim to be the most comprehensive resource out there for planning family road trips in the USA and around the world. The Family Road Trip Blog is helping families create memories that last a lifetime one road trip at a time on our family travel blog.

feeds.title: Thinking Nomads » Road Trips
feeds.description: The main aim is to share, inspire and advise anyone who is interested in independent travel everything from how, what and where. Discussing and exploring alternative ways to live and work while on the road.

feeds.title: The Road Trip Expert » Family Trips
feeds.description: This category contains amazing articles to prepare you for the most incredible family trip! There are posts on packing, itineraries, and entertainment. We've outlined detailed road trip itineraries all over the globe and country-specific advice to make your road trip an unforgettable one. The Road Trip Expert is a one-stop resource for everything road trip-related.

feeds.title: Traveling Party of Four » Road Trip Tips
feeds.description: An inspiring family travel blog by Jenny B, a mom traveling with teens. Traveling Party of Four features family travel tips, travel planning printables, destination advice, and some teaching thrown in the mix for you. Helping moms learn to plan travel with confidence by providing travel planning resources and tips, health and wellness guides, and lots of checklists.

feeds.title: Five on the Road
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Nicky, and I am the planner behind all of the adventures you see on our travel blog. Follow our journey through blog where we post our travel guides, stories, tips for road trips and more!

feeds.title: Family Road Trip Guru
feeds.description: Travel guide for educational, fun and affordable family road trips in California and beyond. Get detailed kid-friendly itineraries plus a wealth of travel tips. My name is Tatiana, I am a busy mom with two wonderful kids and a husband who absolutely LOVE to travel.
